name: What is property restoration?
description: Property restoration repairs and rebuilds structures damaged by events like water, fire, or storms, returning them to pre-damage condition.

acceptedAnswer.text: Property restoration involves repairing and rebuilding structures damaged by events like water leaks, fire, storms, or mold. It aims to return the property to its pre-damage condition. This process often includes emergency services like water extraction or board-up, followed by thorough cleaning, structural drying, and reconstruction work to restore safety and functionality. Hometelligent Inc. specializes in these comprehensive restoration services, focusing on structural integrity and aesthetic repair.
